visual_motion: resetDefaultPose each setup; spine swing .2/.03, tail swing inverted .2/.42 with phase3; wings flap mirrored .2/.51 phase7; root walk X inverted .2/.09 phase7.3; all driven by ageInTicks at constant amplitude1, not limb movement speed.
Citadel walk is X rotation, not root vertical bob. Spectre supplies no explicit model rootY oscillation. Do not label root walk as hover lift.

root adds interpolated birdPitch*DEG_TO_RAD using Minecraft frameTime rather than age fractional time. prevBirdPitch stored immediately before update in entity tick; birdPitch=-deltaY*.5*RAD_TO_DEG. No local clamp to pitch.

Spine/tail and wings remain procedural regardless walking, stationary, leashed or goal; setupAnim ignores netHeadYaw/headPitch. No ModelAnimator or own attack/death clips. Inherited death behavior not fully studied.
actual_motion_consumer: isNoGravity always true, tick sets noPhysics=true after super.tick; does not prove a safe collision implementation for target. isFlying always true. Actor yaw follows deltaX/Z each tick, bodyYaw same.

Nested MoveHelperController MOVE_TO: distance<.3 sets WAIT and halves existing velocity once; else adds normalized displacement*speedModifier*.05. No hover-height servo or carrier constraints. A private canReach collision sweep exists but has no call in selected whole EntitySpectre.

FlyGoal no lure: chooses cardinal15block forward point or island orbit. Normal targetY70..71 when heightmap<15, otherwise terrain+10..19. Start direction randomize literal2+nextInt(3), only indices2,3,4; not all four horizontal directions.

Island check20tick, circlingTime increases until>100 then false and check1200. Orbit radius5..14, angle THREE_STARTING_ANGLE*±circlingTime; selected Maths confirms3degree increment. islandtarget Y min(terrain+10,currentY+nextInt(3)-nextInt(1)); last random term always0.
FlyGoal stop resets island/checktime/radius/time/direction/target, but not controller operation or velocity. A stop does not itself mean rest or landing. circlingTime>0 decays while nonisland.

TemptHeartGoal queries nearest player64 ignoring LOS/invisibility, checks held lure ingredient; canContinue calls canUse; start copies lurePos, stop clears it and waits100 ticks. tick within squared6.25 stops navigation, otherwise writes controller target at player eyeheight. Navigation stop alone is not proven to clear custom move controller/inertia. Item artwork is outside this research.
tether_not_grasp: No startRiding/positionRider/hand-bone passenger relationship in whole class. Leash holder receives directional squared-distance component*.4 impulse when separation>10 (non-fence); descendingY damped*.7, fallDistance0; crouch drops leash. This pulls the holder to Spectre, not a four-person load solver.

tickLeash: passenger holder or fence delegates vanilla; else distance>30 pulls Spectre back to holder with same component formula. Restore tag and death drop processed. No direct guarantee of total distance, contact or transport safety from selected code.
